events.name: New York Yankees at Detroit Tigers

headlines.description: — Riley Greene homered and Kevin McGonigle drove in two runs as the Detroit Tigers beat Gerrit Cole for the first time in 10 years, winning 5-3 against the New York Yankees on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Riley Greene and Framber Valdez lead Tigers past Gerrit Cole, Yankees 5-3 for 4th straight win

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Michael Wacha allowed one run over seven strong innings while Lane Thomas and Carter Jensen had RBI to push the Kansas City Royals past the Tampa Bay Rays 2-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Michael Wacha fires 7 quality innings to spur Royals to 2-1 victory in Tampa Bay

headlines.description: — Brandon Nimmo had three hits and walked once, Alejandro Osuna hit a go-ahead RBI double and the Texas Rangers beat the Miami Marlins 4-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nimmo's 3 hits, Osuna's go-ahead double lift Rangers to 4-3 win over Marlins

headlines.description: — Curtis Mead and Luis Garcia Jr. homered, Foster Griffin pitched 7 1/3 strong innings and the Nationals beat the Phillies 4-1 on Monday night in the opener of a four-game series between the division rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mead and Garcia Jr. homer, Griffin pitches into 8th inning and Nationals beat Phillies 4-1

events.name: Houston Astros at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Pinch-hitter Myles Straw drove in the go-ahead run in the seventh inning with one of Toronto's three sacrifice flies, and Kazuma Okamoto homered to help the Blue Jays beat the Houston Astros 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kazuma Okamoto homers and Blue Jays' bullpen shuts the door in 4-2 victory over Astros

events.name: Chicago Cubs at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Brandon Woodruff took a perfect game into the sixth inning in his return and Joey Ortiz's sacrifice fly in the 10th drove home the go-ahead run as the first-place Milwaukee Brewers beat the Cincinnati Reds 2-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Woodruff's stellar return and Ortiz's sacrifice fly in 10th lift Brewers to 2-1 win over Reds

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sam Antonacci had a walk-off two-run single in the bottom of the ninth inning after Cleveland scored twice in the top half to take the lead and the Chicago White Sox beat the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Antonacci's walk-off two-run single in ninth lifts White Sox over Guardians 6-5

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Minnesota Twins

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani hit a leadoff home run, Freddie Freeman also went deep to break a sixth-inning tie and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Minnesota Twins 2-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shohei Ohtani and Freddie Freeman homer for the Dodgers in their 2-1 win over the Twins

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Rookies JJ Wetherholt and Nathan Church each had two hits, sparking the St. Louis Cardinals to a 3-2 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wetherholt, Church, Pallante key Cardinals' 3-2 win over Diamondbacks

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Jake McCarthy hit a three-run triple down the left-field line in the ninth inning and the Colorado Rockies rallied to beat the Boston Red Sox...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake McCarthy hits 3-run triple in 9th inning as Rockies rally for 3-2 win over Red Sox

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Kyle Bradish pitched eight shutout innings, Taylor Ward hit a leadoff home run against his former team and the Baltimore Orioles extended their winning streak to three games Monday night with a 6-1 victory over the Los Angeles Angels.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Bradish dominates for 8 innings as Orioles roll to 6-1 victory over Angels

events.name: Atlanta Braves at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Manny Machado homered and Michael King pitched seven strong innings for his first win since May 18 as the San Diego Padres beat the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves 1-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Machado homers and King pitches 7 strong innings as Padres beat NL East-leading Braves 1-0
